text:
sam: Heads-up from vendor - eu-west1 H100 on-demand pool is entering a soft-cap window tonight 23:00-02:00 UTC due to a regional backend patch. They warned on-demand + fallback standby may be deprioritized. Link: https://vendor.portal/notice/TKT-9001
maya: Are reserved/dedicated pools unaffected?
vendor-bot: Dedicated/reserved reservations are honored. Soft-cap applies to on-demand, spot and standby fallback in eu-west1 only. Us-central unaffected.
sam: Short plan: 1) tag non-critical projects as evictable; 2) set runtime flag to prefer us-central for long jobs; 3) request emergency protection for our primary CI project. Can we canary first?
liam: I can prepare TF and a tiny scheduler override. TF snippet I'll push: ```resource "redwood_project_tag" "evictable_eu_peak" { name = "evictable-eu-peak" } resource "redwood_project_alloc" "staging21" { project = "proj-staging-21" tags = [redwood_project_tag.evictable_eu_peak.name] }```
liam: Will open PR and hold apply until canary success. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4345 (draft).
ci-bot: Canary job started on proj-staging-21 at 22:40 UTC. Job id: ci-224466. Will report scheduling region and any delay.
maya: If vendor can only protect one project, prioritize proj-ci-main. I'll open the ticket now. vendor-bot  can you attach support ticket for one protected project?
vendor-bot: Support ticket TKT-9001 opened. You may request one protected project for the soft-cap window. Reply in ticket with project name to expedite.
sam: Request submitted for proj-ci-main. Also I added a runtime feature-flag name `eu_softcap_20241020` so we can flip the us-central preference without a deploy.
liam: Scheduler override (runtime) snippet for reviewers: `scheduling_overrides: { project: "proj-sweep-9", preferred_regions: ["us-central"], weight: 5 }` Will not change before canary.
ci-bot: Canary finished: ci-224466 delayed ~35s, landed in eu-west1 standby and completed successfully. No failures.
liam: Good signal. Holding apply until vendor confirms protection for CI. If protection denied, we will flip the runtime flag and move builds to us-central for the window.
vendor-bot: Update: protection granted for proj-ci-main for the window (TKT-9001).
maya: Great. @liam please apply tagging to proj-staging-21 and proj-demo-4 at 22:55 UTC, then bulk at 23:05 if telemetry looks stable. I'll also silence autoscaler noisy alerts for 3h starting 22:45 UTC.
liam: Applying canary tag now, running terraform apply in dry-run then apply at 22:55 UTC. Watchlist: autoscaler.register_timeouts and cross-region fallback counts.
sam: If anything spikes, revert flag and route jobs manually. Also note billing: cross-region egress could be incurred if we force prefer_region changes; only use as last resort.
maya: I'll post a short note to #general about possible delayed starts for non-prod EU jobs tonight and the mitigation. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
